objective: Compare a positive explicit BG1 fixed-branch population search with family-specific and full trailing-wildcard candidates using complete stable-ID sets.

date_window.mode: local post-filter after complete raw traversal

prior_positive_evidence.reason_for_selection: The exact branch was non-zero in Pilot 004 and uses all 26 explicit population terms.

acceptance_checks: Every event receives exact query readback and strict two-pass complete capture.
Every explicit and wildcard comparison is non-zero.
The fresh explicit baseline reproduces the Pilot 004 stable-ID union.
Each family wildcard set contains its corresponding explicit stable-ID union.
The two full wildcard runs have identical totals, order, and stable IDs.
The full wildcard set contains the complete explicit stable-ID union.
Every wildcard-only record is inspected before any source translation decision.
